audit_items.proof_trace: The collateral ADL is a concentration-reduction mechanism (triggered when `total_deposit > target_amount`), not a bad-debt coverage mechanism. The `liquidation_incentive_base` and `liquidation_incentive_daily_penalty` ADL parameters explicitly enable a positive, time-growing operator incentive bounded by `.min(max_liquidation_incentive)`, and the comment at L656 confirms this is the design intent. Setting `liquidation_revenue_factor = float::zero()` (no protocol cut) alongside a positive operator incentive is a deliberate, paired design choice — the property assertion `seized_value <= bad_debt_covered` conflates incentivized concentration-servicing with bad-debt coverage.
